text: This report responds to City Council's July 19, 2023, direction that requests City agencies and corporations to adopt and amend their organization's Executive Compensation Policy to align with the City Guiding Principles for the Development of Senior Executive Compensation. Further, City Council directed the Boards of City agencies and corporations to provide their Board-approved adopted or amended Executive Compensation Policy to the City Manager by the first quarter of 2024.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved the Exhibition Place Executive Compensation Policy in Appendix A to the report (January 19, 2024) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place.
